title: Hana-Kimi
description: HanakimiHana KimiJapanese-American track-and-field star Mizuki has gotten herself to transfer to a high school in Japan…but not just any school! To be close to her idol, high jumper Izumi Sano, she’s going to an all-guys’ high school…and disguising herself as a boy! But as fate would have it, they’re more than classmates…they’re roommates! Now, Mizuki must keep her secret in the classroom, the locker room, and her own bedroom. And her classmates–and the school nurse–must cope with a new transfer student who may make them question their own orientation…

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Ashiya Mizuki is a girl but she attends an all-boys school because high jumper Sano Izumi is there.

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: The school doctor Umeda and Sano figure out that Mizuki is a girl. Can she continue staying at the school?

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: After Sano stops his friend Rika from slapping Mizuki and yells at Rika, Mizuki and Sano get into a fight.

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Sano decides to rejoin the track team, but then his old rival Kagurazaka shows up to provoke him.

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Sano doesn't seem to remember the last night, but Mizuki also has other troubles: someone has it out for her.

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Mizuki's brother Shizuki unexpectedly comes to Japan. Can she keep keep her secret while he's here?

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Dorm 2 is being renovated, so Mizuki needs a place to stay for 2 weeks. Desperate, she turns to Umeda...

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Tamami is all over Sano, putting Mizuki into a strange mood about her and Sano's relationship.

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Io asks Mizuki if she wants things with Sano to stay this way. Later, Mizuki is in danger!

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: It's festival time for Osaka High. The winning dorms gets special privileges, so things get heated.

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Dorm 1 plays dirty in the chicken fight against Mizuki's team. Later Nanba has a heated exchange with a woman.

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Sano's jumping well, and he seems happier. Nakatsu's still confused about Mizuki, but then a girl asks him out?!

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Even though Nakatsu is dating Komatsu, he can't stop thinking about Mizuki. Meanwhile, Mizuki starts karate...

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: An unexpected visitor arrives before the school trip, turning Mizuki's daily life upside down.

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Everyone is enjoying the trip to Hokkaido. But Sano is lost in thought and wanders off, so Mizuki follows him.

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: During her midnight bath, Mizuki runs into Sano. Shaken by this, she can't look him in the eyes the next day.

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Julia's worried that someone might find out that Mizuki is a girl. But then Sano's words rock her to the core.

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: The picture of Sano, Nakatsu, and Nanba goes viral with girls. A fashion photographer is also interested.

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Akiha talks the gang into doing a test shoot. He's a good photographer, but is he also Umeda's boyfriend?

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: The photos turned out great, but Sano's not interested in modeling. So Akiha tries to convince Mizuki.

episodes_data.title: Hana-Kimi Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Someone sabotaged the shoot and destroyed the photos. So now they're doing a shoot on location.
